exposure: homozygous c.1501C>T variant in the RFWD3 gene
outcome: chromosomal breaks (diepoxybutane test, mitomycin C-induced peripheral blood cultures)
cohort: The study describes a 10-year-old male suspected of having Fanconi anemia due to various clinical findings.
finding: The homozygous c.1501C>T variant in the RFWD3 gene was detected in the patient, confirming its association with Fanconi anemia complementation group W and expanding the clinical and molecular spectrum of the disease.
